newsitem.title: USA: Europe FX rates in line with fundamentals -Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Europe FX rates in line with fundamentals -Ciampi.

text.p: Italian Treasury and Budget Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said Sunday that economic fundamentals in Europe were good and that exchange rates were broadly consistent with them.

In remarks before the International Monetary Fund Interim Committee, Ciampi also said the recently unveiled 1997 Italian budget has produced a favorable market reaction and that significantly lower interest rates are now in sight.
"Economic fundamentals in Europe are good with exchange rates broadly consistent with them, budget deficits on the decline and inflation near historical lows," Ciampi said.
Ciampi also told the Interim Committee that because of the new budget, "significantly lower nominal, and in a second time real, rates are now in sight."

Ciampi also said it was essential to preserve the IMF role and operational capabilities, noting that the Fund's liquidity position has gradually weakened and in the not-so-distant future could fall below safe levels.

"We must not allow this to happen," he said. He called for an increase in the Fund's overall quotas but said it should go hand in hand with a realignment of individual quotas to make them better reflect members' relative weight in the world economy.
